steps.name: StaticShardedDO spreads writes over shards, and all() reads each one back
SQLSchemaMigrations records the last migration in each shard's storage
tryAll keeps a failure in its shard, and all() throws the first error
tryN retries a failing object call until it succeeds
wikis and migration state survive a sleep, and the ALTER TABLE does not run again
wikis and migration state survive an orange dev and engine restart
RegionPlacer runs a Worker method through a placed object, by both of its routes

changes.what: Adds the README's TenantDO class to the test fixture Worker (test/workers-test.ts), routes that use SQLSchemaMigrations, StaticShardedDO, stubByName, and tryN, and its binding and migration in test/wrangler.toml.
changes.why: library: no deployable Worker in the repository. The fixture Worker and the region-placer example serve only the region placer routes, and do not reach the library's state API.
